chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family (SAWW), said:

Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, boasts to His angels of the servant who makes up the night prayer during the day. So He says: O My angels, look at My servant making up what I did not make obligatory upon him; I make you witness that I have indeed forgiven him.

key_terms.تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى: Blessed and Exalted is He; an expression of Allah's majesty and transcendence
key_terms.لَيُبَاهِي: He boasts of or presents proudly before others
key_terms.يَقْضِي: he makes up or performs as a missed act

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for making up the night prayer during the day?
ai.summary: This hadith praises the servant who makes up Salat al-Layl during the daytime after missing it. It shows the great spiritual rank of voluntary worship and that such devotion becomes a means for divine forgiveness.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1428 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said:

"Indeed, Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, takes pride in His angels with the servant who makes up the missed prayers of the night during the day. He says,
'O’ My angels, look at My servant who is fulfilling what I did not obligate upon him. I make you witness that I have forgiven him.'"
